sourcedFrom: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) (undated on cover)
cleanIntro: Springfield's own field strip for the Hellcat. The disassembly lever is interlocked to the magazine, so the order is enforced by the pistol itself.

steps.title: Eye protection, muzzle safe, finger off
steps.action: Point the firearm in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger, and put eye protection on before anything comes apart.
steps.prose: Springfield asks for eye protection at the top of the field strip, not as an afterthought.
steps.quote: POINT FIREARM IN SAFE DIRECTION WHILE KEEPING FINGER OFF THE TRIGGER.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 1, p.20
steps.warn: ALWAYS REMEMBER THE FIREARM IS ABLE TO FIRE WITH OR WITHOUT THE MAGAZINE IN PLACE.

steps.title: Magazine out, firearm unloaded
steps.action: Remove the magazine and unload the firearm.
steps.prose: A Hellcat will fire with or without a magazine in it — the magazine coming out is not the same as the gun being empty.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 2, p.20

steps.title: Lock the slide open — and the trick if it fights you
steps.action: Retract the slide and lock it open by pushing up the slide stop lever.
steps.prose: If that is awkward, Springfield gives an alternative: put an EMPTY magazine in the well, retract fully until it locks, then remove the magazine. Confirm it is empty first or you will load the pistol doing it.
steps.quote: Retract the slide and lock it open by pushing up the slide stop lever
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 3, p.20

steps.title: Look into the chamber
steps.action: Visually inspect the chamber to confirm the firearm is unloaded.
steps.prose: The step the disassembly lever depends on.
steps.quote: Visually inspect the chamber to confirm the firearm is unloaded.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 4, p.20

steps.title: Disassembly lever to 12 o’clock
steps.action: Rotate the disassembly lever clockwise to a vertical 12 o’clock position.
steps.prose: It will not rotate at all unless the magazine is out — the pistol enforces the order for you.
steps.quote: Disassembly lever cannot be rotated unless magazine has been removed.
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 5, p.20
steps.warn: Do not attempt to disassemble this or any other firearm until you have received training and instructions from a competent pistolsmith.

steps.title: Ease the slide off
steps.action: Pull the slide slightly to the rear to release the slide stop, then let it run forward and off the frame under control.
steps.prose: The trigger will not reset at this point; that is expected, not a fault.
steps.caution: Slide is under spring tension. Maintain control.
steps.quote: Pull the slide slightly to the rear to release the slide
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 6, p.20

steps.title: Recoil system out
steps.action: Remove the recoil system from the slide.
steps.prose: It lifts out once the slide is off — do not let it spring.
steps.caution: Spring under tension. Keep it pointed away from your face.
steps.quote: Remove the recoil system from the slide
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 8, p.22

steps.title: Barrel out — strip complete
steps.action: Remove the barrel from the slide.
steps.prose: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil system. That is the whole field strip Springfield publishes.
steps.quote: Remove the barrel from the slide
steps.cite: Springfield Armory Hellcat Operation & Safety Manual — Operation & Safety Manual (no part code printed) — Field Strip, step 9, p.22

deepAbsentReason: The Hellcat manual documents the field strip only, and warns against disassembly beyond it without training from a competent pistolsmith. No detail strip is published, so this listing has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Solvent-wet patch through the bore, correctly sized brush, then dry patches until clean
Wipe the feed ramp and the barrel exterior
A light pass of oil outside; nothing pooled

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Scrub the breech face and around the extractor
Wipe the striker channel DRY — no oil in an ignition channel

cleaning.name: FRAME & MAGAZINES
tasks: Wipe the magazine bodies dry — no oil where ammunition sits

reassembly: Seat the barrel and recoil system in the slide.
Run the slide onto the frame and rotate the disassembly lever back down.
Rack the slide several times before handling further.
fncheck: With the magazine out and chamber confirmed empty, rack the slide and confirm the trigger resets, pointed in a safe direction.
